change_from_v1: v1 used d <= 5 for grouping and quarantine. Inspection of the v1 sheets showed the same photograph at d = 6 (D1, Healthy vs CBB) and repeated PlantVillage leaves at d = 6 to 8, while d = 8 also matched unrelated images (cassava vs maize). v2 groups same-label pairs at d <= 8 and quarantines only at d <= 6. Changed before any model training.
exact_duplicate_rule: keep one copy; priority D1, D4, D6, D3, then path
quarantine_rules: D3 image that is an exact or near copy of a development image
both images of a near-duplicate pair with different research labels
all copies of an exact duplicate with different research labels
grouping: union of near-duplicate pairs (d <= 5) among retained images; no plant/farm/session identifiers exist in any source
